result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow, cluttered sidewalk on one side and an industrial area under an elevated rail structure on the other. There are no marked crossings or traffic calming measures, making the wide roadway feel prioritized for vehicles over pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated areas for pedestrians to cross the two-lane road safely.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans and utility poles on the narrow right-side sidewalk impede movement.

hazards.name: Frequent curb cuts
hazards.description: Multiple driveways for commercial properties create frequent conflict points between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Install high-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Provide designated, safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening
interventions.description: Increase the effective width of the walkway to accommodate pedestrians and remove obstructions.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Shorten crossing distances and improve visibility at potential crossing points.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway without a buffer. Significant obstructions, including a large commercial dumpster and building access points, severely constrain the usable walking space for pedestrians, particularly those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction (Dumpster)
hazards.description: A large commercial dumpster is placed directly on the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the path and forcing pedestrians to maneuver around it.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, in front of the boarding home.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk pavement is cracked and uneven, creating a trip hazard and making it difficult for people using mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible across the foreground sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Clear Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Relocate the large dumpster to an on-street parking space or a dedicated service area to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to ensure a smooth, ADA-compliant path of travel.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The street features a sidewalk on the left side adjacent to mixed-use buildings and a large park on the right. While basic infrastructure like street lighting and a marked bike lane exists, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian crossing treatments and buffers between the walkway and moving traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at the intersection ahead, forcing pedestrians to cross without priority or clear guidance.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to enter the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a two-lane roadway with a sidewalk on the far side but no pedestrian walkway on the near side. The environment lacks marked crossings and traffic calming, though it features mature trees and a grass buffer on the far side.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway on the near side of the street, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and near side of the road

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible for a significant stretch of the road, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing between the park and the other side.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the street.
